notes: The tool can now press a skill the moment the game itself shows it is off cooldown. Set the row's Mode to Ready, run Calibrate-Skills.ps1 from the app folder once, standing in town with nothing on cooldown, and that row fires the instant its tile is ready, waits when the game refuses a cast, and holds still on loading screens instead of guessing. Timed skills now space themselves out so two casts can no longer cancel each other, the word None finally fits inside the With box, and your calibration survives every future update.
